sources.title: Swale.ogg — Small swale trickling into a stream
sources.author: Ksd5 / Siddharth Patil
sources.license_evidence: The exact Wikimedia Commons file page declares CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication. The author requests credit where possible, although attribution is not legally required by CC0.
sources.recommended_credit: Stream recording: Siddharth Patil (Ksd5), CC0 1.0; excerpted and crossfaded.

playback_asset.edits: Used original seconds 0–31. Downsampled to 24 kHz with averaging. Created a 1-second sine-squared overlap of end and start; output contains source seconds 1–30 followed by the blended 30–31/0–1 transition, for a 30-second periodic loop. Converted to 16-bit PCM. No volume normalization applied.

sources.title: Nature sounds ambience in a Dordogne pond.ogg
sources.author: Glaneur de sons
sources.description: Pond in Dordogne, France, at dusk; frogs and crickets singing. This is not a bird recording.
sources.license_evidence: The exact Wikimedia Commons file page declares Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported and records a Freesound license review dated 2014-04-06.
sources.required_credit: Nature sounds ambience in a Dordogne pond — Glaneur de sons, CC BY 3.0. Excerpted, downsampled and crossfaded for looping.
sources.attribution_requirement: Show the author, source link, license link and modification notice in the website's credits/source panel.

playback_asset.edits: Used original seconds 10–41. Downsampled to 24 kHz with averaging. Created a 1-second sine-squared overlap of segment end and start; output contains source seconds 11–40 followed by the blended 40–41/10–11 transition, for a 30-second periodic loop. Converted to 16-bit PCM. No volume normalization applied.

verification.originals: Both Ogg files decoded and metadata inspected with libsndfile/soundfile.
verification.loops: Both WAV files reopened and all PCM frames read back byte-for-byte against the prepared output. Each contains exactly 720000 frames (30 seconds).
verification.subjective_listening: Not independently audited by ear in the asset-generation environment; descriptions come from the verified source pages.
